subject: MA Plan launch — availability check & hosting/meeting details
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@verdantai.com>, Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@verdantai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: MA Plan launch — availability check & hosting/meeting details

Hi Samir / Elena —

Nice to meet you both (virtually). I'm Irene on the Redwood team; we’re excited to kick off the mutual action plan (MAP) for VerdantAI’s evaluation. The goal for the kickoff is to align on success criteria, timelines for the two-week evaluation sprint, and roles for technical/decision stakeholders so we can move to a scoped POC and procurement next month.

Quick asks:
- Can you share who will own procurement and legal (name + email)?
- Which stakeholders should be included for technical demos and security review?
- Availability for a 60-minute kickoff this week or early next week (see proposed slots below).

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 11/16: 09:30–10:30 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 11/17: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00

We can host via Zoom (I’ll circulate the link once we lock a slot). I’m cc’ing Dev (solutions engineering) and Laura (customer success) so we can cover architecture, evaluation metrics, and onboarding items. I’ve attached a first-pass MA Plan and a short kickoff agenda so you have context.

Attachments: MA-Plan-v0.2.pdf; Kickoff-Agenda-v1.docx

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of GTM Strategy (Acting)
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0148
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@verdantai.com>

Subject: Re: MA Plan launch — availability check & hosting/meeting details

Hi Irene —

Thanks — this looks good. I can do Tue 11/16 09:30–10:30 PT. Elena Martinez (cc) will join from our engineering team and will be the technical owner for the evaluation. Procurement/Legal: please loop in our vendor ops contact, Priya Shah (priya.shah@verdantai.com) for contract questions.

Attendees from VerdantAI (confirming):
- Samir Rao — Head of Product (samir.rao@verdantai.com)
- Elena Martinez — Senior Staff Engineer (elena.martinez@verdantai.com)
- Priya Shah — Vendor Ops (priya.shah@verdantai.com) — will join if procurement items come up

Request: can you include a Zoom link and a calendar hold? Also would appreciate a short column in the MA Plan that maps evaluation owners to acceptance criteria so we can route internal approvals.

Thanks,
Samir

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/987654321?pwd=MAKICKOFF
Passcode: verdant123
Calendar: [sent invite to all participants]
Recording: We’ll record and share the recording + notes.

I’ve also added a new column in the attached MA-Plan-v0.2.pdf mapping proposed acceptance owners to each criterion (first-pass). Dev and Laura — can you review the ownership column and add/edit names where appropriate before the meeting?

Kickoff quick agenda (attached Kickoff-Agenda-v1.docx):
- 5m introductions & roles
- 10m evaluation goals & success criteria (Samir/Elena)
- 20m demo of integration approach (Dev + Elena)
- 15m MAP timelines & responsibilities (Irene/Laura)
- 10m procurement path & next steps (Samir/Priya)

Attachments referenced: MA-Plan-v0.2.pdf (first-pass ownership column); Kickoff-Agenda-v1.docx (editable)

If BrightBridge (ops@brightbridge.com) needs a separate technical onboarding invite, they’re welcome to join the demo segment; cc’ing them to coordinate.

Best,
Irene

Thanks all — confirmed for 11/16 09:30 PT. A couple of prep notes from our side:

1) Role coverage on Redwood's side:
- Irene — executive sponsor / MAP owner
- Laura — CS lead (onboarding, acceptance criteria, success metrics)
- Dev — solutions engineering (integration & demo)

2) Evaluation criteria suggestion (we’ll expand in the doc):
- Latency at expected load (p50/p90)
- Cost per 1k inference units at projected throughput
- Security checklist (no PHI leakage, encryption in transit + at rest)
- Integration effort (time to run sample payloads end-to-end)

Dev — can you prep a 10–15 minute demo slice showing the integration path (API keys, VPC options, and a sample request/response)?

See you on the call.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Thanks — see you 11/16 09:30 PT.
